title: When a TRICARE Prime Payment Method on File Counts as Lapsed
content:
For a one-time payment on a fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment, the method on file counts as lapsed when the account shows no payment collected through it since a starting month:

1. where the enrollment was brought back by an Enrollment Reinstatement Review decided overturned (a case of Appeals and Grievances whose subject is the enrollment), the month after the old paid-through date the review recorded;
2. where the enrollment took effect in the current plan year, the month containing its effective date;
3. otherwise the first month of the current plan year.

The current plan year is the calendar year containing today. Payments are counted by posting date, from the first day of the starting month on.

## Worked cases (hypothetical, today in September)

| Records | Starting month | Payments through the method on file posted since then | Lapsed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Review decided overturned, old paid-through date 31 May | June | none | yes |
| Review decided overturned, old paid-through date 31 May | June | one in July | no |
| No such review; effective date 15 March of this year | March | none | yes |
| No such review; effective in an earlier year | January | one in February | no |
